item.title: Whatnot Raises $545M Series G at $20B Valuation for Live Commerce
item.summary: Whatnot, Y Combinator's W20 live commerce platform, closed a $545M Series G at a $20B valuation led by ICONIQ, Lightspeed, and Avra, reporting it has already surpassed its full-year 2025 GMV of $8B+ in the first half of 2026.
